title: Wages, working poverty and labour share by country
description: Statutory monthly minimum wage (ILO, latest year since 2021, PPP dollars), average monthly earnings (ILO, PPP dollars), working poverty rate (ILO modelled estimates), labour income share (ILO, latest year based on national data), the cost of a healthy diet against the minimum wage (FAO, local currency, same year), and OECD average and minimum wages at constant 2025 prices and PPPs.
